set-variable.name: backendRelativePath
set-variable.value: @{ string path = context.Request.MatchedParameters.GetValueOrDefault("path", ""); string requested = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("model", ""); string selected = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("selectedDeployment", ""); if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(requested) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(selected)) { path = path.Replace("deployments/" + requested + "/", "deployments/" + selected + "/"); } return "/" + path.TrimStart('/'); }

set-variable.name: activityLog
set-variable.value: @{ /* Backend Selected */ var arr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JArray>("activityLog", new JArray()); int index = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<int>("backendIndex", 0); JObject backend = (JObject)((JArray)context.Variables["listBackends"])[index]; arr.Add(new JObject { { "Elapsed", context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3") }, { "message", "Using " + backend.Value<string>("label") + " URL: " + backend.Value<string>("url") + " LIMIT: " + context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("shouldLimit", "off") } }); return arr; }

set-variable.name: isTempError
set-variable.value: @{ var statusCode = context.Response?.StatusCode ?? 500; bool isTempError = statusCode == 429 || statusCode == 408 || statusCode == 400 || statusCode >= 500; return isTempError; }

set-variable.name: isPermError
set-variable.value: @{ var isTempError = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<bool>("isTempError", false); var statusCode = context.Response?.StatusCode ?? 500; bool isPermError = !isTempError && (statusCode > 400 && statusCode < 500); return isPermError; }

set-variable.name: activityLog
set-variable.value: @{ /* Response Classified */ var arr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JArray>("activityLog", new JArray()); var statusCode = context.Response?.StatusCode.ToString() ?? "N/A"; var isPermError = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<bool>("isPermError", false); var isTempError = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<bool>("isTempError", false); if (isTempError) { return arr; } var statusSummary = isTempError ? "Temp Error" : (isPermError ? "Perm Error" : "Success"); arr.Add(new JObject { { "Elapsed", context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3") }, { "message", "StatusCode: " + statusCode + " - " + statusSummary } }); return arr; }

set-variable.name: activityLog
set-variable.value: @{ /* No Backend */ var arr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JArray>("activityLog", new JArray()); var priorityBackendIndxs = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JArray>("PriBackendIndxs", new JArray()); int retryCount = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<int>("RetryCount", 0); string message; if (priorityBackendIndxs.Count == 0) { message = "NO BACKENDS: none configured for priority " + context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<int>("RequestPriority", 3); } else if (retryCount <= 0) { message = "NO BACKENDS: retries exhausted"; } else { var backends = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<JArray>("listBackends", new JArray()); bool contextWindowExceeded = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<bool>("contextWindowExceeded", false); var now = DateTime.UtcNow; var throttled = new List<string>(); foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) { JObject b = (JObject)backends[i]; if (contextWindowExceeded && b.Value<string>("label") == "PTU") { continue; } if (!b.Value<bool>("isThrottling")) { continue; } var retryAfter = b.Value<DateTime>("retryAfter"); var secs = retryAfter > now ? (int)Math.Ceiling((retryAfter - now).TotalSeconds) : 0; throttled.Add(b.Value<string>("label") + " - " + string.Format("{0:00}:{1:00}", secs / 60, secs % 60)); } message = "NO BACKENDS: all throttled (" + (throttled.Count > 0 ? string.Join(", ", throttled) : "none") + ")"; } arr.Add(new JObject { { "Elapsed", context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3") }, { "message", message } }); return arr; }

set-variable.name: contextWindowExceeded
set-variable.value: @{ if (context.Response == null) { return context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<bool>("contextWindowExceeded", false); } int statusCode = context.Response.StatusCode; if (statusCode == 400) { try { var body = context.Response.Body.As<JObject>(preserveContent: true); var errorCode = body["error"]?["code"]?.ToString(); if (errorCode == "context_length_exceeded") { return true; } } catch { } } /* Keep existing value if not a context window error */ return context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<bool>("contextWindowExceeded", false); }
